question: A creature has an ability that says 'as this creature enters, choose a creature type.' Later, something enters the battlefield as a copy of that creature. Does the copy automatically get the same creature type that was already chosen for the original, since it's copying that permanent?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the copy does not copy the choice; its controller makes a new choice.
expected.answer: A Clone enters the battlefield as a copy of Adaptive Automaton. Adaptive Automaton reads, in part, “As this creature enters, choose a creature type.” The Clone won’t copy the creature type choice of the Automaton; rather, the controller of the Clone will get to make a new choice.

whyHard: Copy effects copy the printed/copiable characteristics of a permanent, and players extend that to mean every choice ever made for it comes along too. Choices made 'as this enters' are not part of the copiable values, so a copy gets to make its own fresh choice instead of inheriting the original's.
